protocol: Three fresh Chrome processes per backend and model; paired forward/reverse backend order with rotating starting backend. Full original PLY/SH3 inputs; matched cameras and resolution; rendering settings adjusted as closely as possible; radial sorting in all depth-sorted groups; native caching; GSL default sorting and Radix native default 24-bit sorting. All eight backends measure static and moving main and closer side views with a frame-stepped sinusoidal orbit of ±45 degrees. PlayCanvas WebGPU and both GSL backends additionally measure raw stochastic rendering without spatial resolve or temporal accumulation; GSL retains default 16-bit axial front-to-back stochastic sorting. Frame completion includes submission, GPU completion and timestamp-query readback with one frame in flight. Memory records post-GC main and live Worker V8 heaps, external backing and WASM capacity. Viewer retains its update loop with automatic drawing disabled. Radix CPU Worker execution, message round trip and full asynchronous sorting are measured in each full run. All frame, sort, memory and capture results were rerun together. Exact versions and Engine commit are recorded in config.
